seoPage.title: Are EVs Safe in Rain and Floods? Myth vs Reality | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Are EVs Safe in Rain and Floods? Myth vs Reality — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: The myth: EVs are unsafe in monsoon. The reality: roadworthy EVs meet insulation standards — but deep flooding is dangerous for any vehicle, petrol or electric.

editorialSections.title: The myth
paragraphs: Rainy-season posts suggest EVs shock easily or fail in puddles. Certified high-voltage systems are designed with weather in mind — misuse still creates risk.

editorialSections.title: Practical reality
bullets: Normal rain driving is part of everyday ownership for many Indian EV users.
Avoid driving through deep, moving flood water — same guidance as petrol cars.
Charging equipment must be rated and installed for its location (covered, outdoor-rated, etc.).

editorialSections.title: When caution is wise
paragraphs: Submerged pack damage can be serious and expensive — insurance and safety rules apply to any vehicle type.

misconceptions.reality: Rated outdoor gear exists — follow OEM and installer guidance.
Roadworthy systems are tested — avoid unapproved wiring.

faq.question: Can I drive in heavy rain?
faq.answer: Yes with a maintained roadworthy car — avoid deep floods.

faq.question: Is home charging safe in monsoon?
faq.answer: Use certified install — not ad-hoc extensions.

faq.question: What if water enters the cabin?
faq.answer: Stop, assess, and follow insurer/OEM guidance — do not DIY high-voltage work.

faq.question: Are floods different from rain?
faq.answer: Yes — deep flooding is a serious hazard for any vehicle.

faq.question: Compare next?
faq.answer: Factor monsoon range habits when you compare range estimates.
